questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All postcards are envelopes.

No envelope is a paper.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some envelopes are postcards.

II. No paper is an envelope.

III. No postcard is a paper.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The best possible Venn diagram according to the information is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517ae66688acf5afd98a5762c61da5e800af56f553f348becdb5c5ec71635bdd.png] 

I. Some envelopes are postcards → True, as all postcards are envelopes, some envelope will definitely be the postcards.

II. No paper is an envelope → True, as no envelope is a paper.

III. No postcard is a paper → True, as postcards are envelopes, and no envelop is a paper.

Hence, all conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.question: The sum of the current ages of Asma and her grandfather is 80 years. 10 years from now, Asma’s age will be one-fourth of her grandfather’s age. What is Asma’s current age?
questions.solution:
As per the question,

Let current age of Asma be X and that of her grandfather be Y.

Sum of their age = X + Y = 80 …(i)

Age 10 years from now,

X + 10 will be of Asma and Y + 10 of her grandfather, also given that

X + 10 = 1/4 (Y + 10) …(ii)

From (i) X = 80 - Y put in (ii)

80 - Y + 10 = 1/4 (Y + 10)

90 - Y = 1/4 (Y + 10)

360 - 4Y = Y + 10

5Y = 350

Y = 70

Put Y = 70 in (i)

Therefore, X = 10

Hence, 10 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Who presides over the joint sitting of the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker of Lok Sabha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**The __**Speaker of Lok Sabha**__ presides over the joint sitting of the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha.

__
 
• The** Deputy Speaker **of the** Lok Sabha presides **over in his **absence**. If **he is also absent,** then the **Deputy Chairman** of the Rajya Sabha presides over it.
 
• The Chairman never presides over the joint sessions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

A** joint sitting **is summoned in the following*** three situations, ***(in which one House passed the Bill and transmitted it to the other House)

 
• If the other House rejects the bill.
 
• disagreements have arisen between the Houses regarding the amendments to be made in the Bill.
 
• If the other House withhold the Bill without being passing it for more than six months.

The** President** is the one who summons the** joint siting.**

 
• **T**he provision for joint sitting is **not **applicable for ***Money bills and Constitution amendment bills.***

questions.question: Dolly, the first cloned living being created at Roslin Institute in Scotland was a _______.

__
 
• Dolly was a female domestic sheep and the first mammal which was cloned on July 5, 1996__.

 
 
• She was cloned from an adult somatic cell through the process of nuclear transfer.
 
• She was cloned at the Roslin Institute in Midlothian, Scotland, and survived there until her death when she was 6 years old.
 
• Her existence was announced to the public on 22 February 1997.
 
• She was originally code-named “6LL3,” but later on she was named after singer and actress Dolly Parton.
 
 

 
• Cloning

• Cloning of an animal was successfully performed for the first time by Ian Wilmut and his colleagues at the Roslin Institute in Edinburgh, Scotland.

questions.question: What is the value of all tangible resources such as raw materials and labour that are used in the production process called?

__

• Variable Costs are corporate expenses which change in proportion to production output.

questions.question: Two articles are sold for Rs. 4880 each, on one article the seller gained 22% and on the other he lost 20%. What is his overall gain or loss percentage, nearest to one decimal place?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

questions.question: Walking at 3/4 of his usual speed, a person reaches his office 18 minutes late than the usual time. His usual time in minutes is∶
